thread:
Ana (sales): FYI — Polaris pilot kickoff tomorrow morning. Dry-run found three blockers. Can presales/eng help triage quickly?
Victor (presales): TL;DR: long SSE streams drop mid-response, function/toolcall JSON uses snake_case while their validator expects camelCase, and the connector refresh fails against their IdP (missing signed assertion).
Maya (eng): For SSE: SDK keepalive is 25s; their edge proxy drops idle at ~30s under load. Short-term: set heartbeat to 8-10s. Example: `client.setHeartbeat(8000)` or env `SDK_KEEPALIVE_MS=8000`. I'll add snippet to sample app.
Ana (sales): Can that be client-side only? Need to give them a patch now.
Maya (eng): Yes, client-side. Small PR with snippet + README note. Also change sample app to bind ephemeral port by default to avoid the EADDRINUSE we hit.
deploy-bot: deploy failed for `polaris-sample` -> EADDRINUSE:8080
Victor (presales): Schema mismatch: their runtime rejects snake_case keys from our tool outputs. Any compatibility layer?
Maya (eng): We'll add a tiny `toCamelCaseKeys(resp)` helper in examples and a one-line transform in the tool runner. Low risk.
Ana (sales): SSO details?
Victor (presales): Connector tries client_credentials refresh; their IdP requires a signed assertion — logs show `invalid_grant: missing_assertion`.
Maya (eng): Options: (A) enable session-exchange endpoint that accepts signed assertions (preferred by security; needs legal AUP for pilot) or (B) issue a short-lived delegated key for the connector (acceptable for timeboxed pilots). Session-exchange can be enabled in ~24-48h after legal signoff. I'll open JIRA `polaris-session-exchange`.
Ana (sales): Security will likely push for (A). I'll loop legal right away.
Victor (presales): Pricing asked: streaming vs non-streaming token billing and function-call cost.
Maya (eng): Both streaming and batch are billed per token emitted. Function/tool calls add a small per-call metadata fee. For the pilot we can set a capped budget and enable token-level telemetry in the console. Recommend disabling batching for the demo to keep latency predictable.
Ana (sales): Action items: 1) Ana files JIRA & loop legal; 2) Maya pushes PR (heartbeat + key-normalizer + port fix); 3) Victor updates the pilot runbook and pricing note; 4) infra retries deploy after PR.
Maya (eng): Draft PR: `pr/1304-polaris-pilot-fixes` 10-min patch. I'll ping when merged and when session-exchange is toggled. Will standby during the run.
Ana (sales): Thanks team :thumbsup: If anything breaks tomorrow we fallback to non-streaming calls and rollback image.
